name: @appstrate/platform
description: Run tools served by the runtime that executes the run: progress logs, persistent memory (archive notes and pinned slots, the `checkpoint` slot included), memory recall and the agent's past runs. The runtime serves the MCP endpoint and authenticates to it itself (`_meta["dev.appstrate/platform"]`); the declared URL is a reserved `.invalid` host that a runtime unaware of the binding cannot reach, so it leaves the integration unbound.
